description: This file defines the main application entry point for a watchOS app built with SwiftUI. It sets up the app's main scene, manages an inbox store, a connectivity receiver, and coordinates sending replies via WatchConnectivity.

classes.name: OpenClawWatchApp
classes.description: Main application struct conforming to the App protocol, responsible for setting up the app's primary scene and managing communication state.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Defines the main scene of the app, including a window group that hosts the inbox view and manages the communication receiver setup.
